malformed_input.observable: all four direct /places/does-not-exist visits resolve to pathname /, catalog not-found copy, noindex,nofollow, and no invalid share

prompt_injection.observable: hostile img/onerror search remains literal input; image count and injected flag remain zero

stale_state.observable: two passes per viewport preserve catalog-root -> sheet -> catalog-replay -> catalog-root for click and NEXT; direct/reload remain FULL_SCREEN

dirty_worktree.observable: implementation candidate is a committed ancestor; only candidate-bound evidence is staged for the descendant evidence commit

hung_or_long_commands.observable: Vinext runner has a 60s startup deadline, Playwright action timeouts, and bounded 5s teardown

flaky_tests.observable: browser matrix and focused suite each run twice with identical zero-failure outcome

misleading_success_output.observable: verdict derives from URL, DOM, history, focus, scroll, requestfailed, response, and console collections rather than server stdout

repeated_interruptions.observable: diagnostic and full runs each terminate their server/browser; final port and process counts are zero

cancel_resume.reason: no resumable upload, external mutation, live API call, or deployment was started
